lessons.title: Diwali
lessons.big_question: Why do Hindus celebrate Diwali as the victory of good over evil?
aims: DESCRIBE — what Diwali is and when Hindus celebrate it
DISCUSS — why light stands for the victory of good over evil
EXPLAIN — two lessons the story of Rama and Sita teaches

questions: Do you celebrate a religious festival?
If so, which one, and how do you celebrate it?
How do you think Hindus celebrate Diwali?

learn.caption: The story and meaning of the festival of lights

source.quote: The festival takes place on the darkest nights of late autumn. Whichever story is told, it includes light, which stands for the victory of good over evil.
source.task: Underline the words that say when Diwali happens. Then explain why light is used as a symbol.

stretch.question: Explain two lessons we can learn from the festival of Diwali.

debate.statement: Festivals are the best way to teach children right from wrong.
agree: A story like Rama and Sita stays in your memory, so the lesson about good and evil sticks.
Celebrating the same festival every year reminds a whole family of the same values.
disagree: You can learn right from wrong from your family and school without any festival at all.
Many people enjoy the lights and the food at Diwali but never think about the meaning.
debate.how_to_win: Use the story of Rama and Sita as your example, then say what a person really learns from it.

quickfire.q: What are the three views about God in the UK?

lessons.title: The Alien Project
lessons.big_question: What are the symbols of the Big Six religions and what do they mean?
aims: DESCRIBE — what a religious symbol is and why it matters
DISCUSS — the symbols of the Big Six world religions
EXPLAIN — the meaning of the Hindu symbol Aum

questions: Name one religious symbol you already know.
Why might a symbol matter more to a believer than words do?

learn.caption: What each poster must tell the aliens
rows: Its holy book and afterlife belief

source.quote: Aum is said to be the most powerful word ever spoken and is the word used by Brahman to create the whole universe. It is the most holy sound in Hinduism.
source.attrib: — Unit 2 lesson slides, on the Hindu symbol Aum
source.task: Say what Aum is and what Hindus believe it created. Then draw the symbol on your poster.

stretch.question: Explain why the Aum symbol is important to Hindus.

debate.statement: A religion is explained better by a symbol than by words.
agree: A symbol like Aum can be seen and heard, so even an alien would notice it straight away.
One symbol can carry a whole story: the cross tells of Jesus dying and rising again.
disagree: A symbol means nothing until somebody explains it, so the words have to come first.
The crescent moon was used long before Islam, so a symbol on its own can mislead you.
debate.how_to_win: Pick one symbol, say what it stands for, then judge whether that meaning is clear without words.

quickfire.q: What is the difference between fact and belief?

Which religion uses the Dharma Wheel?

lessons.title: The Mandir
lessons.big_question: What is the Mandir and why is it important to Hindus?
aims: DESCRIBE — what a Mandir is and what is found inside
DISCUSS — how Hindus show respect when they enter
EXPLAIN — two reasons the Mandir matters to Hindus

questions: Why are religious buildings important to believers?
What features do you think a Mandir has?
Name one religious building you have heard of.

learn.caption: Inside a Hindu place of worship

source.quote: Firstly, one way the Mandir is important to Hindus is because they can meet the deities. This means that they can show how thankful they are by bringing offerings like food.
source.attrib: — Unit 2 slides, model answer on the Mandir
source.task: Highlight the point and the development. Then write a second reason in the same way.

stretch.question: Explain two reasons why the Mandir is important to Hindus.

debate.statement: It is better to worship at the Mandir than to worship at home.
agree: At the Mandir Hindus can stand in front of the murtis and perform puja properly.
Worshipping with other people makes a Hindu feel part of one big community.
disagree: Hindus can pray at a shrine at home every day without travelling anywhere.
Hindus believe Brahman is in everything, so a building cannot make a prayer more real.
debate.how_to_win: Give one reason for each side, then say which reason you think is stronger and why.

quickfire.q: What is the difference between fact and opinion?

lessons.title: Belief in the afterlife
lessons.big_question: What do Hindus believe happens after death?
aims: DESCRIBE — what Hindus mean by atman and samsara
DISCUSS — how belief in rebirth changes how you live
EXPLAIN — one Hindu teaching about life and death

questions: What do you believe happens when you die?
What is another view that people hold?
Why do people disagree about life after death?

learn.caption: The cycle of life, death and rebirth
rows: How your last life affects the next

source.quote: Humans are stuck in a cycle of death and rebirth called samsara. The goal for atmans is to join Brahman and stop living. The next incarnation depends on how the previous life was lived.
source.attrib: — Unit 2 lesson slides, on Hindu belief after death
source.task: Underline what samsara means. Then write one sentence explaining moksha in your own words.

stretch.question: Explain one Hindu teaching about life and death.

debate.statement: I would like to live multiple lives.
agree: Living many lives would give you more chances to put right the mistakes you made before.
You could watch the world change and find out what life is like as somebody else.
disagree: One life feels precious because you know it will end, so you use your time well.
If you cannot remember your old lives, living again is not really you living again.
debate.how_to_win: Say what you would do with an extra life, then answer the strongest point on the other side.

quickfire.q: What is the Hindu place of worship called?

lessons.title: Hinduism and nature
lessons.big_question: What do Hindus believe about nature and how should we protect it?
aims: DESCRIBE — what Hindus mean by the environment
DISCUSS — how karma affects the way Hindus treat nature
EXPLAIN — two Hindu teachings about the environment

questions: Name one way that people harm the natural world.

learn.caption: Karma, nature and looking after the Earth

source.quote: Do not harm the environment; do not harm the water and the flora; the earth is my mother; I am her son; may the waters remain fresh. Do not harm the water.
source.attrib: — Unit 2 lesson slides, quoting the Vedas
source.task: Summarise this teaching in one sentence. Then give two ways a Hindu could follow it.

stretch.question: Explain two Hindu teachings about the environment.

debate.statement: Religion is the best reason to look after the planet.
agree: Hindus believe harming nature brings bad karma and a worse rebirth, so they take care.
The Vedas call the earth a mother, and people look after a mother without being paid.
disagree: You do not need a religion to see that pollution is damaging everybody's home.
Scientists warn us about the climate, and that reason works for believers and non-believers.
debate.how_to_win: Use the Vedas quote or karma as your evidence, then say what a non-religious person would answer.

learn.caption: The topics your summative test will cover

source.quote: Firstly, one God from the Trimurti is Shiva. This means that Shiva's role is the destroyer, and he is also in charge of life and death.
source.attrib: — Unit 2 slides, model answer on the Trimurti
source.task: Write the second half of this answer about Vishnu, using Secondly and This means that.

stretch.question: Explain two reasons the Mandir is important for Hindus.

debate.statement: A test is the best way to show what you have learned.
agree: A test makes you revise everything, so you find out which topics you have forgotten.
Everybody answers the same questions, so a test is a fair way to compare work.
disagree: A poster like the Alien Project shows understanding better than short written answers.
Some people panic in tests and end up scoring below what they really know.
debate.how_to_win: Compare the test with the Alien Project, then say which one showed your learning best.
